English: Majority of reports of Multisystem Inflammatory Syndrome (MIS-C) associated with COVID-19 have come from Europe and North America, with a paucity of cases in the Asia-Pacific region and Africa.
Luganda: Alipoota ezisinga ez’Okuzimbagatana (MIS-C) okwekuusa ku COVID-19 zivudde mu Bulaaya n’Obukiikakkono bwa America, ng’abalwadde batono nnyo abasangiddwa mu kitundu kya Asia-Pacific ne Africa.
Yoruba: Púpọ̀ nínú àwọn ohun tí wọ́n sọ nípa Ìgbóná nínú oríṣiríṣi ẹ̀yà ara ọmọdé (MIS-C) tí ó ní ìbámu pẹ̀lú COVID-19 ti wa láti Europe àti North America, pẹ̀lú àwọn ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ tí kò pọ̀ ní agbègbè Asia-Pacific àti ní Afirika.
Zulu: Imibiko eminingi ye-Multisystem Inflammatory Syndrome (MIS-C) ehlotshaniswa ne-COVID-19 ivele eYurophu naseNyakatho Melika, ngokuntuleka kwamacala esifundeni sase-Asia-Pacific nase-Afrika.
Hausa: Yawancin rahotanni na Cutar Kumburin Sassan Jiki (MIS-C) da suke da alaƙa da cutar COVID-19 sun fito ne daga ƙasashen Turai da Arewacin Amurka, tare da ƙarancin faruwa a yankin Asiya-Pacific da kuma Afirka.
Northern Sotho: Bontši bja dipego tša Sintoromo ya go Kokomoga ga Ditho tša mmele tše mmalwa (MIS-C) tše di amanago le COVID-19 di tšwa go Yuropa le Amerika Leboa, ka tlhaelelo ya malwetši ka seleteng sa Asia-Pacific le Afrika.
Amharic: ከኮቪድ-19 ጋር የተገናኙት የመልቲ ሲስተም ኢንፍላማቶሪ ሲንድረም (ኤምአይኤስ-ሲ) አብዛኛዎቹ ዘገባዎች ከአውሮፓ እና ከሰሜን አሜሪካ የመጡ ናቸው፣ በእስያ-ፓሲፊክ ክልል እና በአፍሪካ ያሉ ጉዳዮች አነስተኛ ናቸው።

English: The paucity of reports in Africa is in contrast with the demographics of the series in New York, Paris and UK which reported that children of African ancestry accounted for 40%, 57% and 75%, respectively of all cases of MIS-C.
Luganda: Omuwendo gwa alipoota omutono oguva mu Africa gukontana n’ebibalo ebiva mu New York, Paris ne UK ebiraga nti abaana abalina ensibuko mu Africa bakola ebitundu 40%, 57% ne 75%, mu busengeke obwo eby’abantu bonna abalina MIS-C.
Yoruba: Wọ́n sọ àwọn ohun tí kò pọ̀ ní Áfíríkà tí ó sì ní ìfiwéra pẹ̀lú òdiwọn àwọn ènìyàn ní New York, Paris àti UK tí ó sọ nípa ìrandíran àwọn ọmọdé ní Áfíríkà pẹ̀lú ṣíṣe ìṣirò ìdá 40%, ìdá 57% àti ìdá 75% gbogbo ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ MIS-C.
Zulu: Ukushoda kwemibiko e-Afrika kuphambene nezibalo zabantu zochungechunge eNew York, eParis nase-UK olubike ukuthi izingane zabokhokho base-Afrika zibalelwa ku-40%, 57% kanye no-75%, ngokulandelana kwazo zonke izimo ze-MIS-C.
Hausa: Karancin rahotanni a Afirka ya sha bamban da ƙididdigar da aka yi a birnin New York da Paris da kuma UK waɗanda suka bayar da rahoton cewa, yara ‘yan asalin Afirka sun kai kashi 40% da kashi 57% da kuma kashi 75%, bi-da-bi na dukkan faruwar MIS-C.
Northern Sotho: Tlhaelelo ya dipego ka Afrika ga e sepelelane le dipalopalo tša ditatelano go la New York, Paris le UK tšeo di begilego gore bana ba lešika la Afrika ba be ba bopa 40%, 57% le 75%, ka go latelana tša malwetši ka moka a MIS-C.
Amharic: በአፍሪካ ያለው የዘገባዎች ማነስ በኒውዮርክ፣ ፓሪስ እና ዩኬ ከተዘጋጁት ተከታታይ የስነ-ሕዝብ መረጃዎች በተቃራኒ የአፍሪካ የዘር ግንድ ልጆች 40%፣ 57% እና 75%፣ የኤምአይኤስ-ሲ ጉዳዮችን በተከታታይ ይሸፍናሉ፣ በአፍሪካ የዘር ግንድ ልጆች ላይ ኤምአይኤስ-ሲ በከፍተኛ ደረጃ እየተስፋፋ ካለው ዓለም አቀፍ.

English: With the global trend of higher prevalence of MIS-C in children of African ancestry, enhanced surveillance and awareness for this syndrome in children with COVID-19 in Africa is therefore important as the previous and current observations of Kawasaki Disease (KD) and MIS-C as a rarity in Africa may be due to under-reporting, a poor index of suspicion and missed diagnosis.
Luganda: Ng’emiwendo gya MIS-C gyeyongera mu nsi yonna mu baana abalina ensibuko mu Africa, kikulu okwongera ku kukebera n’okumanyisa ebikwata ku bulwadde buno mu baana abalina COVID-19 mu Africa kubanga okutwala Obulwadde bwa Kawasaki (KD) ne MIS-C ng’obutalabika nnyo mu Africa kiyinza okuba nga kiva ku kuba nti abalwadde batono abategeezebwa, abasawo obutateebereza nti buyinza okuba nti bwebwo n’obutabuzuula mu kukebera.
Yoruba: Pẹ̀lú ìgbode kàn ìtànkálẹ̀ MIS-C tó ga jùlọ lágbàáyé nínú àwọn ọmọdé ní àwọn ìrandíran ní Áfíríkà, ṣíṣàfikún ìtọpinpin àti mímọ àpapọ̀ onírúnrú àmì àìsàn nínú àwọn ọmọdé tí wọ́n ní COVID-19 ní Áfíríkà, tí ó sì jẹ́ èyí tó ṣe pàtàkì gẹ́gẹ́ bíi àbá ti tẹ́lẹ̀ àti àbá ti ìsín fún ààrùn tó má ń fa ibà, ojú pípọ́n lára àwọn ọmọdé ààrùn (KD) àti MIS-C tí ò wọ́pọ̀ ní Áfíríkà léè jẹ́ àìrọ̀yìn, ìtọ́ka ìfura sí tí kò dára àti ìwádìí àìsàn tọ́ ti pàdánù.
Zulu: Ngokuthambekela komhlaba wonke kokusabalala okuphezulu kwe-MIS-C kubantwana bokhokho base-Afrika, ukubhekwa okuthuthukisiwe nokuqwashisa ngalesi sifo ezinganeni ezine-COVID-19 e-Afrika ngakho-ke kubalulekile njengokubonwa kwangaphambilini namanje kwe-Kawasaki Disease (KD) kanye ne-MIS- C njengevelakancane e-Afrika kungase kube ngenxa yokungabikwa kahle, inkomba engalungile yokusola kanye nokuxilongwa okugejiwe.
Hausa: Tare da yanayin duniya na yaɗuwar MIS-C a cikin yara ‘yan asalin Afirka, ingantaccen sa-ido da wayar da kan jama'a game da wannan ciwo a cikin yara masu fama da cutar COVID-19 a Afirka yana da mahimmanci kamar yadda aka lura a baya da kuma a yanzu na Cutar Kawasaki (KD) kuma MIS- C a matsayin ƙaranci a Afirka yana iya kasancewa saboda rashin bayar da rahoto yadda ya kamata, wato rashin sanin alamun cutar sosai da kuma rasa gano cutar bisa kuskure.
Northern Sotho: Ka setlwaedi sa lefaseng ka bophara sa go atafala ga phetetšo tša godimo tša MIS-C go bana ba lešika la Afrika, kgoboketšo ya tshedimošo ye e kaonafaditšwego le temogo ya sintoromo ye go bana bao ba nago le COVID-19 ka Afrika ka gona e bohlokwa ka ge ditemogo tša peleng le tša bjale tša Bolwetši bja Kawasaki (KD) le MIS-C bjalo ka yeo e hlagago ka sewelo go la Afrika e ka bakwa ke go fana ka dipego tša ka fase, intekse ye e sa kgotsofatšego ya pelaelo le phekolo ye e fetilwego.
Amharic: አዝማሚያ ጋር በአፍሪካ ውስጥ ከኮቪድ-19 ጋር ላሉ ህጻናት የተሻሻለ ክትትል እና ግንዛቤ በአፍሪካ የካዋሳኪ በሽታ (ኬዲ) እና ኤምአይኤስ-ሲ የቀድሞ እና ወቅታዊ ምልከታዎች አስፈላጊ ናቸው፣ በአፍሪካ ውስጥ እንደ ብርቅ ነገር ዝቅተኛ ሪፖርት ባለማድረግ፣ ደካማ የጥርጣሬ መረጃ ጠቋሚ እና ምርመራ ባለማለፉ ምክንያት ሊሆን ይችላል።

English: A case report of a 12-year old Nigerian girl with MIS-C is presented in line with the WHO call for urgent reporting and global surveillance especially in areas were MIS-C is considered a rarity.
Luganda: Alipoota ekwata ku muwala ow’emyaka 12 mu Nigeria eyalina MIS-C eragibwa wano mu kugoberera omulanga gwa WHO ogw’okutegeeza mu bwangu n’okukebera mu nsi yonna naddala mu bitundu MIS-C gye kutwalibwa nti kutono.
Yoruba: Ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ tí wọ́n sọ nípa ọmọbìrin Nàìjíríà kan tí ó jẹ́ ọmọ ọdún 12 ní wọ́n ṣe àgbẹ́kalẹ̀ nígbà tí àjọ WHO pẹ̀ fún àwọn àlàyé ní kíákíá àti ṣíṣọ́ ni lágbàáyé pàápàá jùlọ ní agbègbè tí MIS-C kò ti wọ́pọ̀.
Zulu: Umbiko wecala lentombazane yaseNigeria eneminyaka engu-12 ubudala ene-MIS-C wethulwa ngokuhambisana nekhwelo le-WHO lokubikwa okuphuthumayo kanye nokubhekwa komhlaba wonke ikakhulukazi ezindaweni lapho i-MIS-C ibhekwa njengento eyivelakancane.
Hausa: Rahoton wata yarinya ‘yar Nijeriya mai shekaru 12 da take ɗauke da MIS-C an gabatar da shi daidai da kiran da WHO ta yi na a bayar da rahoto cikin gaggawa da sa-ido a duniya musamman a yankunan da ake ɗaukar MIS-C a matsayin ƙaranci.
Northern Sotho: Pego ya bolwetši ya mosetsana wa Nigeria wa mengwaga ye 12 yo a nago le MIS-C e tšweletšwa go sepelelana le boipiletšo bja WHO go fana ka pego ya tšhoganetšo le kgoboketšo ya tshedimošo ya lefase kudukudu go mafelo ao MIS-C e bonwago e le hlaga ka sewelo.
Amharic: የ12 ዓመቷ ናይጄሪያዊ ልጃገረድ የጉዳይ ሪፖርት ከኤምአይኤስ-ሲ ጋር በተገናኘ በWHO አስቸኳይ ሪፖርት እንዲደረግ ጥሪ ቀረበ እና ዓለም አቀፍ ክትትል በተለይ በኤምአይኤስ-ሲ እንደ ብርቅ በሚታይባቸው አካባቢዎች።

English: This case report stimulates a call for vigilance and expanded effort at surveillance to promote early recognition and diagnosis of MIS-C in Africa; using current case definitions which promote the recognition of MIS-C in areas of resource limitation.
Luganda: Alipoota y’omulwadde eno ereetawo obwetaavu bw’okufaayo ennyo n’okwongera ku kaweefube w’okukebera okwongera ku busobozi bw’okulaba n’okuzuula MIS-C mu Africa; okukozesa ennyinyonnyola eziriwo ezongera ku busobozi bw’okulaba MIS-C mu bitundu ebitaliimu bikozesebwa bimala.
Yoruba: Ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ tí wọ́n sọ yìí ṣe ìgbàníyànjú fún ìpè ìṣọ́rafún àti ìfojú balẹ̀ àti ṣiṣe akiyan ìtànkálẹ̀ ìtọpinpin láti ṣe ìgbéga ìtètè dámọ̀ àti àyẹ̀wò MIS-C ní Áfíríkà; lílo àwọn oríkì ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ tí ó ṣẹ̀ṣẹ̀ ṣẹlẹ̀ tí ó ṣe ìgbéga dídá MIS-C mọ̀ ní àwọn agbègbè àwọn ohun ọrọ̀ tí kò tó nǹkan.
Zulu: Lo mbiko wecala ugqugquzela ikhwelo lokuqapha kanye nomzamo owandisiwe ekuqapheni ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukuqashelwa kusenesikhathi kanye nokuxilongwa kwe-MIS-C e-Afrika; kusetshenziswa izincazelo zamanje ezikhuthaza ukuqashelwa kwe-MIS-C ezindaweni zokukhawulela izinsiza.
Hausa: Wannan rahoton faruwar yana ƙarfafa kira don faɗakarwa da faɗaɗa ƙoƙarin sa-ido domin haɓaka ganewa da wuri da ganewar MIS-C a Afirka; ta yin amfani da ma'anoni na halin yanzu waɗanda suke haɓaka fahimtar MIS-C a cikin yankuna masu ƙarancin na’urori.
Northern Sotho: Pego ye ya bolwetši e hlohleletša boipiletšo bja go ntšha mahlo dinameng le maitekelo ao a katološitšwego go kgoboketšo ya tshedimošo go hlohleletša temogo le semeetseng le phekolo ya MIS-C ka Afrika; go šomišwa ditlhalošo tša bolwetši tšeo di hlohleletšago temogo ya MIS-C go ditikologo tše di itemogelago tlhaelelo ya methopo.
Amharic: ይህ የጉዳይ ዘገባ በአፍሪካ የኤምአይኤስ-ሲን እውቅና በንብረት ውስንነት ላይ የሚያበረታቱ የወቅቱን የጉዳይ ፍቺዎችን በመጠቀም፤ የኤምአይኤስ-ሲ ቀዳሚ እውቅና እና ምርመራን ለማበረታታት የንቃት ጥሪ እና የክትትል ጥረትን ያበረታታል።

English: The favourable outcome and experience from this case will create awareness, expand knowledge, and support clinicians on the African continent in their approach to other potential cases.
Luganda: Ebiva n’ebiyigirwa ku mulwadde ono bijja kwongera ku kumanya, okwongera amagezi, n’okuyamba ku basawo ku Ssemazinga wa Africa mu ngeri gye bakwatamu abalala abayinza okuba n’obulwadde obwo.
Yoruba: Àbájáde tó dára àti ìrírí nínú àwọn ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ yìí yóò pàsè ìmoye, yóò jẹ́ kí ìmọ̀ gbòòrò si, tí yóò sì ṣe àtìlẹ́yìn fún àwọn dọ́kítà aṣètọ́jú aláìsàn tó wà ní ilẹ̀ Áfíríkà sí ìwòye wọn sí àwọn ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ tí ó ṣeéṣe kí ó ṣẹlẹ̀.
Zulu: Umphumela omuhle kanye nolwazi oluvela kuleli cala luzodala ukuqwashisa, lwandise ulwazi, futhi lusekele odokotela ezwenikazi lase-Afrika endleleni yabo yokubhekana nezinye izimo ezingase zibe khona.
Hausa: Kyakkyawan sakamako da gogewa daga wannan faruwa za ta haifar da wayar da kan jama'a da faɗaɗa ilimi da tallafa wa likitocin a nahiyar Afirka game da yadda za su iya fuskantar wasu matsaloli masu yiwuwa.
Northern Sotho: Dipoelo tše di kgotsofatšago le maitemogelo go tšwa go bolwetši bjo di tla hlola temogo, tša oketša tsebo, le go thekga dingaka ka kontinenteng ya Afrika ge ba šogana le malwetši a mangwe ao a ka hlagago.
Amharic: በዚህ ጉዳይ ላይ ያለው ጥሩ ውጤት እና ልምድ በአፍሪካ አህጉር ላይ ግንዛቤን ይፈጥራል፣ እውቀትን ያሰፋፋል፣ እና ሌሎች ሊሆኑ የሚችሉ ጉዳዮችን በተመለከተ ክሊኒኮችን ይደግፋል።

English: In 2020, researchers looked into the case of the first child in Nigeria with severe Covid-19 disease to develop multisystem inflammatory syndrome (MIS-C).
